transcript.text: Watch this and write a short English voice-over explaining what's happening. Replace the original conversation with your narration, friendly and matter-of-fact. Keep all 10 seconds of footage unchanged, with no music or captions. You pick the wording and voice.

transcript.why: The reply says it cannot do the requested task with its tools: it cannot watch the video, and it cannot add new audio to the original footage without changing the picture. It then offers alternatives and asks which one the user wants. The main content is the inability, so "cannot" fits better than "question," even though the reply ends by asking for a choice.
